name: Spirit Totem
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
The elemental spirits of this place don't be likin' me any more.

You know about the totems more than any, and I be needin' a spirit totem to protect me.  We already got the elements, now we need somethin' more with more nature.  More primal.

In the Western Plaguelands you can kill bears for claws and spiders for their eyes.  The carrion birds eat everything, so they might have either one.
narrative.objectives: Bring the pieces for the spirit totem to Bath'rah the Windwatcher.
narrative.offerRewardText: Great, mon! Let's try it out...
narrative.requestItemsText: The spirits know what we're up to, and they been tryin' to kill me! I hope you got the parts.
